name: linkedin-networking
description: Compliant networking helper: find companies to research and Haas / MBA alumni to reach out to, then draft outreach and track it. NEVER touches LinkedIn (no scraping, no reading profiles, no auto-send) — it sources companies from off-LinkedIn data, builds Sales Navigator search URLs for you to click manually, drafts messages via the product-networking skill, and logs contacts to a private Google Sheet. Auto-fires on LinkedIn URLs / networking intent via a UserPromptSubmit hook.
